assetType.name: Crypto
description:
I use Orion Terminal to scan for top gainers and losers. I trade based on market sentiment, personal intuition, and real-time price action. 

My Approach:
    - I look for volatile assets that are moving and open when I see strong “momentum”.
    - I mostly trade mid-low cap coins. 
    - The portfolio is a mix of day trades and short-term swings. 

Risk Management:
    - No leverage. 
    - Strict 10-25% entry size per trade.
    - Max. 2 open trades at any time so it is manageable. 
    - My "max loss" is typically around -40%. 
    - I take profits when the trend shifts, TP hits or if I’m happy with the profits.

My Trading Hours & Updates:
    - UK (Local): 5:00 am – 10:00 pm
    - Europe (CET): 6:00 am – 11:00 pm
    - US East Coast (ET): 12:00 am – 5:00 pm
    - US Central (CT): 11:00 pm – 4:00 pm
    - US Mountain (MT): 10:00 pm – 3:00 pm
    - US West Coast (PT): 9:00 pm – 2:00 pm
    - India (IST): 10:30 am – 3:30 am
    - Australia (AEST): 3:00 pm – 8:00 am
